optOut.missing: This email has no opt-out line, so it cannot be sent. Use Insert opt-out to add it.
optOut.notSetUp: No opt-out sentence is set up, so no outreach email can be sent. Add one on the Templates tab’s Signature panel.
optOut.notLoaded: The opt-out sentence has not loaded yet, so this cannot be sent.
optOut.unreadable: The opt-out sentence could not be read, so nothing was sent.

retry.notRebuilt: That message could not be rebuilt with the company line, so nothing was sent.
